**Get it on [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/startrekoutpostsunknown/mods/3)**, or download `LukasMods-STOU-QuartersMaster-1.0.0.zip` below. It's the same archive as the one on Nexus, byte for byte: sha256 `f2110efeaa2597332b96c8b4db4b105b43d5225f8a6dde67a08f8ac2d5816413`.

See where your crew sleeps. Habitat pickers badge crew portraits with the game's planet or ship icon, and crew cards get a QUARTERS row. Display only: it never assigns or moves anyone.

Needs the Steam version of the game and BepInEx 6.0.0-be.790 (Unity IL2CPP, win-x64), the exact build it was tested with: [our BepInEx pack on Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/startrekoutpostsunknown/mods/2). Extract this zip into your game folder, so the DLL lands in `BepInEx\plugins\QuartersMaster`. Install and full details: [Quarters Master guide](https://github.com/lukas-mods/Lukas-Mods/blob/main/guides/star-trek-outposts-unknown/quarters-master.md).

> ⚠️ **Use at Your Own Risk.** Any mod can crash a game or damage a save, so back up your saves first: copy `userdata\<your Steam account number>\3469910\remote\` from your Steam folder somewhere safe.

## 1.0.0 - First Release

- Habitat pickers badge crew portraits with the game's planet or ship icon, showing where they sleep.
- Crew without a bed in a habitat are listed first in habitat pickers; everyone else keeps the game's order.
- Crew cards get a QUARTERS row under STATIONED: the planet's name, or SHIP.
- Display only: it never assigns or moves anyone.
